lines.zh: 冰面上滑一步，金粉落在霜里。
lines.en: One slide on the ice, gold dust on the frost.

lines.zh: 翅膀擦过冰拱门，落下细碎金屑。
lines.en: My wings brush the ice arch and shed fine gold.

lines.zh: 循着月光在冰壳上挪动六足。
lines.en: Six feet creep along the ice shell, following moonlight.

lines.zh: 霜太滑，我只好贴地飞一小段。
lines.en: The frost is slick, so I skim low for a while.

lines.zh: 冰冻深海的风把我吹偏了半尺。
lines.en: The frozen deep's wind pushed me half a foot off.

lines.zh: 金翅扇一下，寒气就散开一圈。
lines.en: One beat of gold wings pushes the chill aside.

lines.zh: 沿着冰缝走，那里盐味最淡。
lines.en: I follow the ice cracks, where the salt tastes faintest.

lines.zh: 小心绕过薄冰，掉下去就上不来。
lines.en: Careful around thin ice; fall through and I never rise.

lines.zh: 我的影子映在冰里，是金色的。
lines.en: My shadow in the ice is the color of gold.

lines.zh: 每一步都留下小小的融痕。
lines.en: Every step I take leaves a tiny melted print.

lines.zh: 冰拱门下比外面暖一点点。
lines.en: Under the ice arch it is a little warmer.

lines.zh: 夜里冰面反光，正好照路。
lines.en: At night the ice throws light and shows my path.

lines.zh: 翅膀边缘结了霜，飞得沉了些。
lines.en: Frost on my wing edges makes my flying heavy.

lines.zh: 三滴血的身子，走远路要歇两次。
lines.en: Three drops of life, so I rest twice on long trips.

lines.zh: 冰裂声在脚下，我轻轻掠过。
lines.en: Ice cracks below me. I skim past.

lines.zh: 顺着沉船的桅杆影子走。
lines.en: I follow the shadow of a sunken mast.

lines.zh: 金粉落在冰上，像一小片火。
lines.en: Gold dust on the ice looks like tiny fire.

lines.zh: 风停了，我才敢张开翅膀。
lines.en: The wind dies. Only then do I spread my wings.

lines.zh: 我把金粉抖在冰上，像撒了碎星。
lines.en: I shake gold dust on the ice like scattered stars.

lines.zh: 趴着不动时，翅膀还会轻轻发亮。
lines.en: Even resting, my wings keep a soft shine.

lines.zh: 冰下有条鱼游过，我看了很久。
lines.en: A fish swam beneath the ice; I watched a long while.

lines.zh: 三滴血，也够我慢慢活着。
lines.en: Three drops of blood are enough to live slowly.

lines.zh: 我在等夜更深，霜更亮。
lines.en: I wait for deeper night and brighter frost.

lines.zh: 金粉积在触角上，得理一理。
lines.en: Gold dust collects on my antennae; I must groom them.

lines.zh: 冰拱门的影子慢慢转了个方向。
lines.en: The ice arch's shadow slowly turned its direction.

lines.zh: 有人把玻璃瓶留在了冰上。
lines.en: Someone left a glass bottle on the ice.

lines.zh: 我不怕冷，只怕被装进瓶子。
lines.en: Cold does not scare me; the bottle does.

lines.zh: 深海在冰下呼吸，声音很闷。
lines.en: The deep breathes under the ice, muffled and low.

lines.zh: 翅膀合起来，像一枚小金片。
lines.en: Folded wings look like one small gold flake.

lines.zh: 夜里的冰面比白天更硬。
lines.en: The ice is harder at night than by day.

lines.zh: 我数着冰上的裂缝，一共七道。
lines.en: I counted the cracks in the ice: seven of them.

lines.zh: 停在这里，金粉就不会被风吹散。
lines.en: Staying here keeps wind from scattering my gold.

lines.zh: 你踩冰的动静，比海风响多了。
lines.en: Your boots on ice are louder than the sea wind.

lines.zh: 金粉别蹭，沾上很难洗。
lines.en: Mind the gold dust; it will not wash off.

lines.zh: 你手上那个瓶子，我认得。
lines.en: I know that bottle in your hand.

lines.zh: 你站得这么近，是想捉我吗。
lines.en: Standing that close, do you mean to catch me?

lines.zh: 夜里很少有这么大的活物来。
lines.en: Few living things this large come out at night.

lines.zh: 你的火把把冰照得不冷了。
lines.en: Your torch makes the ice look less cold.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你看得太久，脖子酸。
lines.en: I looked up at you so long my neck aches.

lines.zh: 你靴底带了陆地的泥。
lines.en: There is mainland mud on your boot soles.

lines.zh: 别伸手，我的翅膀会掉金屑。
lines.en: Do not reach out; my wings shed gold flakes.

lines.zh: 你看我像看一块会动的金子。
lines.en: You look at me like moving gold.

lines.zh: 才三滴血，一下就没了三分之一。
lines.en: Three drops of life; one hit takes a third.

lines.zh: 我的金粉被震落了一地。
lines.en: The blow shook my gold dust to the ground.

lines.zh: 翅膀破了个口，飞起来漏风。
lines.en: A tear in my wing lets the wind through.

lines.zh: 别打，我连瓶子都撞不破。
lines.en: Do not hit; I cannot even crack a bottle.

lines.zh: 这一下让我贴在冰上半天。
lines.en: That hit pinned me to the ice a long while.

lines.zh: 我的触角折了一根，歪着。
lines.en: One antenna is bent and hangs crooked.

lines.zh: 疼得我把金粉都收了起来。
lines.en: It hurts so much my gold dimmed.

lines.zh: 三滴血，掉一滴就少一分亮。
lines.en: Three drops; losing one dims me.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，金屑落了满身。
lines.en: I shook, and gold flakes fell all over me.

lines.zh: 冰面接住了我，没让我摔下去。
lines.en: The ice caught me before I fell.

lines.zh: 金粒？我自己的粉就够多了。
lines.en: Gold nuggets? I already shed plenty of my own.

lines.zh: 你把金锭举高，我有点想看。
lines.en: Hold the gold ingot up; I do want a look.

lines.zh: 那点金光，比我翅膀还亮。
lines.en: That glint is brighter than my wings.

lines.zh: 我不吃金子，我只落在上面。
lines.en: I do not eat gold; I only land on it.

lines.zh: 瓶子收起来，我就靠近一点。
lines.en: Put the bottle away and I will come closer.

lines.zh: 你手心是暖的，冰面不是。
lines.en: Your palm is warm; the ice is not.

lines.zh: 金粉换金锭，这买卖不亏。
lines.en: Gold dust for an ingot is not a bad trade.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的手飞了两圈。
lines.en: I circled your hand twice already.

lines.zh: 别晃，金光晃得我眼花。
lines.en: Stop waving it; the glare blurs my eyes.

lines.zh: 再近一步，我就落在你指节上。
lines.en: One step closer and I land on your knuckle.

lines.zh: 撞上你，金粉撒了你一袖子。
lines.en: Bumping you spilled gold dust down your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我太轻，撞你像落了一片叶子。
lines.en: I am so light, hitting you feels like a leaf.

lines.zh: 你挡住了冰拱门的风口。
lines.en: You are blocking the arch's wind gap.

lines.zh: 让一让，我的六足躲不开靴子。
lines.en: Step aside; six feet cannot dodge a boot.

lines.zh: 三滴血，撞一下就晃半天。
lines.en: Three drops of life; one bump leaves me reeling.

lines.zh: 我贴着你裤脚走，那里挡风。
lines.en: I walk by your trouser leg; it blocks the wind.

lines.zh: 抱歉，冰面太滑，我刹不住。
lines.en: Sorry, the ice is too slick to brake.

lines.zh: 你脚下那道冰缝差点吞了我。
lines.en: That crack by your feet nearly swallowed me.

lines.zh: 我和你一起滑出去半步。
lines.en: We slid half a step together.

lines.zh: 别踩，我在你鞋尖前面。
lines.en: Do not step; I am just before your toe.

lines.zh: 冰拱门下，两只金蛾会一起发亮。
lines.en: Under the arch, two golden moths shine together.

lines.zh: 夜里的金粉要成对才好看。
lines.en: Gold dust looks right only in pairs at night.

lines.zh: 我用触角碰了碰另一对翅膀。
lines.en: I touched another pair of wings with my antennae.

lines.zh: 冰面上并排走，影子叠成一片金。
lines.en: Side by side, our shadows merge into gold.

lines.zh: 三滴血的命，也想留下一点金粉。
lines.en: Three drops of life still want to leave gold dust.

lines.zh: 我们把卵藏在冰缝里，冻不坏。
lines.en: We hide our eggs in ice cracks; frost cannot kill them.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀比我薄，飞得更轻。
lines.en: Its wings are thinner, so its flight is lighter.

lines.zh: 冰拱门的顶，正好挡风又挡雪。
lines.en: The arch roof blocks both wind and snow.

lines.zh: 两只金蛾一起，霜都显得暖了。
lines.en: Two golden moths make the frost seem warm.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，这算是我们的时刻。
lines.en: Not too close, please; this moment is ours.

lines.zh: 金粒归我，反正是我掉的。
lines.en: That nugget is mine; I dropped it anyway.

lines.zh: 我抱起一颗金粒，比我还沉。
lines.en: I lift one nugget; it weighs more than I do.

lines.zh: 掉在冰上的金子，我一颗颗捡。
lines.en: I pick up the gold dropped on the ice, one by one.

lines.zh: 这枚金锭，我拖不动，只好推。
lines.en: This ingot I cannot carry, so I push it.

lines.zh: 瓶子我不捡，那东西会关人。
lines.en: I leave the bottle; that thing imprisons.

lines.zh: 冰缝里卡着金屑，我够得着。
lines.en: Gold flakes stuck in the crack are within reach.

lines.zh: 捡来的金粉，我藏进翅膀下。
lines.en: I hide the gathered dust beneath my wings.

lines.zh: 谁丢的钥匙？亮得不像金子。
lines.en: Whose key is this? It shines unlike gold.

lines.zh: 太重了，我叼着走三步就歇。
lines.en: Too heavy; I carry it three steps and rest.

lines.zh: 我拖着战利品，在冰上划出细线。
lines.en: I drag my prize, scratching a thin line on the ice.

lines.zh: 你的火把灭了，我才敢靠近。
lines.en: Your torch went out; now I dare come near.

lines.zh: 那个人一直没动，我去看看。
lines.en: That one has not moved; I will go look.

lines.zh: 我认出了你腰间的玻璃瓶。
lines.en: I recognized the glass bottle at your belt.

lines.zh: 冰面上多了一个影子，我盯着它。
lines.en: A new shadow on the ice; I keep my eyes on it.

lines.zh: 你手里的金锭在夜里太显眼。
lines.en: Your gold ingot is far too bright tonight.

lines.zh: 我决定绕着这个大家伙飞一圈。
lines.en: I decided to circle this big creature once.

lines.zh: 有东西在冰拱门后喘气，我去瞧。
lines.en: Something breathes behind the arch; I will check.

lines.zh: 你在敲冰，声音传得很远。
lines.en: You are knocking the ice; the sound carries far.

lines.zh: 我锁定了那点亮光，慢慢挪过去。
lines.en: I fixed on that glimmer and crept toward it.

lines.zh: 目标不算威胁，但值得我看一眼。
lines.en: Not a threat, but worth a closer look.

lines.zh: 我悬在你肩旁，翅膀几乎不响。
lines.en: I hover by your shoulder, wings almost silent.

lines.zh: 金光落在你脸上，你先别动。
lines.en: Gold light falls on your face; hold still.

lines.zh: 我在数你呼吸的间隔。
lines.en: I am counting the gaps between your breaths.

lines.zh: 你一动，我就退半尺。
lines.en: Move, and I retreat half a foot.

lines.zh: 冰面把我的影子送到你脚边。
lines.en: The ice carries my shadow to your feet.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，找没有风的那一侧。
lines.en: I circle you, hunting the windless side.

lines.zh: 你袖口沾的金粉，是我的。
lines.en: The gold dust on your cuff is mine.

lines.zh: 我盯着你手里的瓶子，不放。
lines.en: I keep my eyes fixed on that bottle.

lines.zh: 近了，我能听见你靴里的雪。
lines.en: Closer now; I hear snow crunch in your boots.

lines.zh: 只要你不开瓶盖，我们就相安。
lines.en: As long as the lid stays shut, we are at peace.

lines.zh: 我撞你一下，等于挠痒。
lines.en: My charge at you amounts to a tickle.

lines.zh: 翅膀拍你手背，只留一层金粉。
lines.en: Wings slap your hand, leaving only gold dust.

lines.zh: 我也想咬，可我没有牙。
lines.en: I would bite, but I have no teeth.

lines.zh: 三滴血的身子，打不过任何东西。
lines.en: With three drops of life I beat nothing.

lines.zh: 这一下用尽了我全部力气。
lines.en: That one blow used all my strength.

lines.zh: 我的角只是触角，顶不疼人。
lines.en: My horns are antennae; they do not hurt.

lines.zh: 别还手，我会碎在冰上。
lines.en: Do not hit back; I would shatter on the ice.

lines.zh: 我扑过去，然后被风推回来。
lines.en: I lunged, and the wind pushed me back.

lines.zh: 金粉进了你眼睛，算我赢吗。
lines.en: Gold dust in your eyes: do I win?

lines.zh: 我只会用翅膀扇，扇完就喘。
lines.en: I can only fan my wings, then I pant.

lines.zh: 冰面裂开一线，我从缝里钻出。
lines.en: A line splits the ice and I crawl out.

lines.zh: 冰冻深海的夜，把我送到冰壳上。
lines.en: The frozen deep's night set me on the ice shell.

lines.zh: 我出生在冰拱门的阴影里。
lines.en: I was born in the shadow of an ice arch.

lines.zh: 第一口空气，冷得像刀。
lines.en: My first breath cuts like a blade.

lines.zh: 翅膀还湿，得先晾一会儿。
lines.en: My wings are wet; I must dry them first.

lines.zh: 金粉从一出生就在抖。
lines.en: I have been shedding gold since birth.

lines.zh: 我落在冰上，六足一时站不稳。
lines.en: I land on the ice, six feet unsteady.

lines.zh: 四周全是霜，没有一棵草。
lines.en: Frost everywhere, not one blade of grass.

lines.zh: 深海在下面响，我在上面亮。
lines.en: The deep rumbles below; I shine above.

lines.zh: 夜还长，我慢慢把翅膀展开。
lines.en: The night is long; I unfold my wings slowly.

lines.zh: 火一燎，我的金翅卷了边。
lines.en: One lick of flame curled my gold wing.

lines.zh: 从冰拱门摔下，我的粉全散了。
lines.en: Falling from the arch scattered all my dust.

lines.zh: 冰水灌进翅膀，我浮不起来。
lines.en: Icy water fills my wings; I cannot float.

lines.zh: 炸开的气浪把我的金粉吹光了。
lines.en: The blast blew every speck of my gold away.

lines.zh: 箭穿了我的翅膀，我打着转落。
lines.en: An arrow through my wing, I spiral down.

lines.zh: 那股魔力让我身上的金都暗了。
lines.en: That magic dimmed the gold all over me.

lines.zh: 冰上没有花蜜，我饿得发轻。
lines.en: No nectar on the ice; hunger makes me light.

lines.zh: 雷落在冰面，我的翅膀麻了。
lines.en: Lightning struck the ice and my wings went numb.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，连金粉都留不下。
lines.en: In the void, not even my gold dust remains.
